info.name: Zorviq API - End-to-End AI Code Generation Suite
info.description: Importable Postman v2.1 collection for the current Zorviq backend. Change BASE_URL once to point every API request at your backend. Covers auth/email flows, projects, Bedrock-powered code generation, RAG-assisted generation through Gemini/Pinecone, export ZIP, GitHub OAuth/deploy, provider smoke tests, and negative validation checks.
